Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in statistics calculations caused test failures despite correct workbook structure.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple '#NAME?' errors in cells H46 through L47. This indicates the workbook is using undefined names or unsupported functions in the 'statistics' section. While test_file_and_sheet_structure and test_lookup_blocks passed, the final statistical assertions failed: 'H46: expected -3.5737762237762265, got #NAME?'. Avoid using Excel functions that require specific add-ins or non-standard named ranges not defined in the script.
